description: Use this when the user asks to change one of their CAD drawings in words ("make the kitchen 4.2 m wide", "move the garage to the left", "add a window to bedroom 2"). The drafter makes the change as a new version (earlier versions stay in the studio). Spends credits from the user's AI Architectures account (usually 60 to 600 per change). Then call get_cad_drawing.

change.description: What should change, in the user's words.

name: change_cad_drawing
title: Change a CAD drawing
